primaryWrittenSources.basis: Management plan, Figure 81 description and written building history. Minaret north-west, small northern court, western raised yard and a western gate. 1939 work introduced pointed arches and alhor stone façade covering and stairs around the original minaret.
The sacred western gate was reinstalled on 19 September 2016. The gate is reached by the courtyard associated with the historic burials.
Documents the former burial enclosure as the large western court, a small northern courtyard giving access to the minaret, and the building’s long history of remodelling.

excludedReference: The nominally CC0 1988 door photo credits a commercial library, without a first-party release.
next: Advance to Birch Memorial Clock Tower.
scope: The standing Sidi Yahya Mosque after the restoration of its western gate in 2016. Includes the mapped prayer hall and curved mihrab, square tapered minaret, northern forecourt, and the adjoining walled western court and gate.
geometryBasis: Named native way 308864956 locates the hall and eastern mihrab. Adjoining native way 308864954 fixes the northwest envelope at the plaza. The low western court occupies the open strip south of that wing and east of the mapped street.
sectionBasis: Rubble-like alhor stone, tapering mud-and-stone minaret with timber ends and rounded crest, low flat roof, thicker northern buttresses, recessed pointed portals, and open courts. Main eaves use the proportions of the historical image and the fixed map dimensions.
limitations: The mapped prayer hall and adjacent northwestern outline provide the exterior boundaries. The western court enclosure, setback, internal walls, roof levels and minaret height use approximate dimensions.

The early public-domain images show the structure before the 1939 work. Present-era pointed arches, stone facing and the reconstructed timber gate are based on written accounts and approximate architectural details.
The original terrain is preserved. Finished courtyard grades and thresholds are approximate at available DEM resolution.
